name: smwsprites-punch
title: Punch
description:
Straight from Wario Land II, with differences. He energetically hops along the ground, and upon seeing you he delivers a furious Straight Punch, which will send you flying if it connects. If stomped on, bumped from behind or hit with a fireball, he will not be defeated; instead he just hides in his helmet and is pushed back a bit. The only ways to beat it is with a Star or thrown item. Yoshi can eat it too.

Details are included in the ASM file, and GFX are included in the ZIP. They use SP3.

Give credit if used or tweaked.
